title: Workspace layout template
description: A declarative workspace layout. `layout` is a FlexLayout model consumed by Model.fromJson — pure data, no code is executed (Tier 1). Mirror of src/shared/layouts/template-manifest.ts. Reference only core/default-enabled panel components (agent, terminal, editor, explorer, file-editor, content-search, git, memory-graph); components from a disabled module render as an empty surface.

description.description: One-line description shown in the layout picker.

previewSlots.description: Optional thumbnail metadata for the picker preview.

layout.description: FlexLayout IJsonModel. The root layout node must be a row.
